subject: Invoice channel preference & sample payloads for onboarding
excerpt: Quick thread coordinating Acme's preferred invoice intake channel (portal vs email), required PO fields, and a request for compact sample rows to validate our ingest pipeline.
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Lena Ortiz <billing@acme-corp.com>, procurement@biomedsolutions.com
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Invoice channel preference & sample payloads for onboarding

Hi Lena / Acme procurement team,

Thanks again for the quick kickoff today. To get the vendor activation moving we need a simple decision from you so our AP intake and engineering teams can finalize the onboarding: portal-first or SMTP/email fallback. Two quick clarifying asks so we can validate your invoices against our ingest rules: 1) Will you submit invoices via your portal (preferred) or by sending PDFs/CSVs to a dedicated email address? 2) Can you confirm the mandatory fields you will include on each invoice: PO number, invoice date, total, line items with unit price, tax/VAT line, and billing entity name?

If you can, please attach a single sample invoice (PDF or CSV) or a compact CSV with 3 exemplar rows so my team can run it through our parser. I attached a tiny sample-invoice-csv.csv for reference.

Next steps from us: if portal, we’ll issue an activation token and share a short onboarding form to capture legal entity and remit-to details; if email, we’ll share subject conventions and an ack token that must be present in the subject line for idempotency.

Appreciate a response today if possible — aiming to schedule the AP test ingest for Thursday.

Thanks,
Jordan Blake
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

Attachments: sample-invoice-csv.csv (3 rows, CSV)

From: Lena Ortiz <billing@acme-corp.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@biomedsolutions.com
Date: Tue, 22 Jun 2027 11:04:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Invoice channel preference & sample payloads for onboarding

Hi Jordan —

Thanks — we can do portal-first. Our procurement team prefers a portal because it gives us visibility across entity hierarchies. That said, we will need an email fallback for the initial 4 weeks while we finish our vendor admin work.

A couple of items from our side:
- VAT is required on all EU invoices; we will send VAT number in the invoice metadata when applicable.
- PO stamping: our PO numbers are mandatory and must be present either in invoice metadata or the subject line (we’ll confirm final format).
- Billing entity: we operate under two legal entities (Acme Corp US and Acme EU Ltd). We can include the entity code as a separate column if that helps.

I’ll attach a representative PDF and a compact CSV export from our ERP — sending shortly. We’d also appreciate a one-paragraph description of the email subject/token convention if we opt for the fallback path.

— Lena
Lena Ortiz
Head of Billing Operations, Acme Corp
billing@acme-corp.com

Attachments: acme_example_invoice.pdf

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Lena Ortiz <billing@acme-corp.com>
Date: Tue, 22 Jun 2027 14:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Invoice channel preference & sample payloads for onboarding

Karthik / Marissa — fyi Acme prefers portal-first with 4-week email fallback. They have multi-entity billing and VAT on EU invoices. Lena will provide sample files. Can you confirm the minimal set of columns we require for portal import and our proposed subject token for email fallback?

Pleasantly, the test ingest needs to happen by Thu — can we prioritize the compact schema validation?

Jordan

On Tue, 22 Jun 2027 at 11:04 AM Lena Ortiz <billing@acme-corp.com> wrote:
> Hi Jordan —
> 
> Thanks — we can do portal-first...
>

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 23 Jun 2027 09:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Invoice channel preference & sample payloads for onboarding

Jordan / team —

Thanks for the context. For portal ingestion we require the following minimal CSV column set (we can map additional columns but these are required for automatic matching):
- invoice_number
- invoice_date (YYYY-MM-DD)
- total_amount (decimal)
- currency (ISO-4217)
- po_number
- supplier_name
- billing_entity_code (optional but strongly recommended for multi-entity accounts)
- line_items (we accept a delimited subfield; if not provided we will attempt line item extraction from PDF)
- tax_amount and tax_rate OR vat_number (for EU invoices)

Guidance for email fallback (short): please send PDFs to invoices+acme@inbound.redwood.com with the subject formatted as: ACME|<legal-entity-code>|PO:<po_number>|<ack-token>. The ack-token will be issued to you and must be present so our ingest returns proper idempotency and prevents duplicates. Example subject: ACME|US|PO:123456|ACK-9f2a

I’ve attached compact-sample-rows.csv with three canonical rows to validate our parser and the vendor-onboarding-form.pdf we ask vendors to complete for remit details. A few internal notes:
- If VAT is present we’ll prefer tax_amount + tax_rate fields for structured parsing.
- For multi-entity vendors we’ll perform a quick preflight mapping — if Acme supplies the billing_entity_code we will route invoices to the correct ledger automatically.

Let me know if Lena can drop the sample CSV and we’ll run a dry ingest in our sandbox.

Thanks,
Karthik
Product Ops — Ingest Team
Redwood Inference

Attachments: compact-sample-rows.csv, vendor-onboarding-form.pdf

From: Lena Ortiz <billing@acme-corp.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 25 Jun 2027 15:42:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Invoice channel preference & sample payloads for onboarding

Thanks, Karthik — that format looks good to us.

We attached the requested compact CSV (three rows) and confirmed we will put the legal-entity code in a separate column called billing_entity_code. For the email fallback we’ll include the subject token as you specified and will send to invoices+acme@inbound.redwood.com during the transition window.

Questions for clarity before the test ingest:
1) Timeline: can you confirm when you’ll run the sandbox ingest and when we can expect go/no-go?
2) Error feedback: if an invoice fails parsing during the test, what form will the error report take (CSV with row-level errors, or a link in the portal)?

Once we have those two items we’ll schedule the internal change freeze and communicate the guidance to our AP team.

Lena Ortiz
Head of Billing Operations, Acme Corp
